conditions.B0: Read-only prepared source search and reading.
conditions.P1: B0 source tools plus read-only VulRIS relation queries.

metric: A dataset case is a hit when a submitted candidate or a CodeQL alert matches the reference vulnerability cause and affected code path.
selection: Retrospective final adopted submissions; the rates describe this collection, not prospective first-attempt success probabilities.
source_version_alignment: B0/P1 use the final corrected inputs. Exact parity between corrected LLM inputs and historical CodeQL source versions has not been verified for all cases. CodeQL counts are descriptive results of the recorded baseline.
aggregation: Three paired Top1 datasets, 395 dataset cases. Report each dataset separately.
historical_profiles: Legacy Vul4J non-Top1 results were withdrawn and deleted from the current tree.
vul4j_top1: The separate October 9–10 P1 Top1 experiment has 79 completed reviews. No matched Top1 B0 is recorded. It is not mixed into the paired table.
